project_type: Next.js 16.2.4 App Router web app (Personal Budget Tracker) with React 19, TypeScript 5, Tailwind CSS v4. Supabase (Postgres + Auth) backend, Tesseract.js client-side OCR, Google Gemini AI receipt parsing, Recharts charts, lucide-react icons.
build_system: npm (package-lock.json present). Node not on default PATH: use `bash -lc` which sources nvm (Node v22.23.2 available, also 18/20/24). Run all node/npm commands via `bash -lc '...'`.
test_framework: None. No unit/integration test suite exists in the repo. QA verification is manual/live via a running dev server plus browser automation (playwright / agent-browser powers). Static verification via `npm run build` and `npm run lint`.
test_command: bash -lc 'cd /projects/sandbox/kiro-web-playground && npm run lint' (no automated test suite; functional testing is manual against `npm run dev` on http://localhost:3000)
verification_instructions: 1) Checkout the branch under audit. 2) `npm install`. 3) `npm run build` and `npm run lint` to establish static baseline and catch compile/type/lint errors. 4) Start dev server with `npm run dev` (run_in_background) on port 3000. 5) Drive the running app with the playwright/agent-browser powers: exercise landing page, login, signup, and (auth-gated) dashboard/scan/transactions/budgets/settings. 6) Capture console errors, network failures, responsive breakpoints (mobile/tablet/desktop), keyboard nav, and screenshots. 7) Record every finding in the report.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in. `.next/` build output is generated and gitignored.
setup_instructions: The audited application lives on remote branch origin/feature/budget-tracker (commit d563b5edd90ab59e8c092bc456c64306110de97b), NOT on main (main is a stock create-next-app starter). Create a git worktree or a new local branch from origin/feature/budget-tracker to get the full app source into the working tree. Example: `git worktree add ../bt-audit origin/feature/budget-tracker` OR `git checkout -b qa-budget-tracker origin/feature/budget-tracker`. Then `bash -lc 'npm install'`. The QA report file (QA_AUDIT_REPORT.md) must be produced.
environment_constraints: Network mode OPEN_INTERNET (npm install, external API calls allowed). HOWEVER the app requires external credentials that are NOT present: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY (Supabase auth + all data CRUD), and GEMINI_API_KEY (receipt AI parsing). There is NO .env.example / .env.local on the branch. Without Supabase keys: login/signup, and every authenticated page (dashboard, transactions, budgets, settings, scan) cannot load real data; middleware calls supabase.auth.getUser() which will error or the browser client will throw with placeholder/undefined env vars. Features requiring these credentials that cannot be exercised end-to-end must be documented as 'Blocked' in the QA summary, not silently passed. What CAN be tested without credentials: static build/lint, the public landing page (app/page.tsx), login & signup page rendering + client-side validation (HTML5 required/type=email/minLength), routing/redirect behavior, responsive layout, accessibility (semantic HTML, labels, focus, contrast), console errors on load, and code-level review of validation/security/auth logic. Note in the report exactly which items are Blocked and why.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md warns this Next.js 16.2.4 has breaking changes vs older versions; consult node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing/running Next-specific code. Global steering rule in effect: every web app must use responsive Tailwind CSS utility classes and Semantic HTML for all layout sections; factor this into UI/accessibility review and any suggested fixes.
key_patterns: All app pages are client components ('use client') that instantiate the Supabase browser client and fetch data in useEffect. Auth gating is enforced by middleware.ts -> lib/supabase/middleware.ts (protectedPaths dashboard/scan/transactions/budgets/settings redirect to /login when no user; authPaths login/signup redirect to /dashboard when logged in). Route groups: app/(app)/* authed layout with sidebar+mobile menu, app/(auth)/* login/signup. CRUD via supabase-js directly from the client (RLS enforced server-side in supabase/schema.sql). CSV export builds a Blob client-side. Receipt scan: Tesseract OCR in browser -> POST /api/parse-receipt -> Gemini. formatCurrency/formatDate/getMonthKey helpers in lib/utils.ts.
relevant_files: app/(app)/dashboard/page.tsx (Recharts pie/bar/line, summary cards, budget progress)
app/api/parse-receipt/route.ts (Gemini call, JSON.parse of AI output)
app/globals.css (theme tokens, dark mode via prefers-color-scheme)
directory_structure: app/ (App Router: route groups (app) authed and (auth), api/parse-receipt, auth/callback). lib/ (supabase clients, ocr, utils, types). middleware.ts at root. supabase/schema.sql. Standard Next config: next.config.ts, tsconfig.json, eslint.config.mjs, postcss.config.mjs.
